defaults.audio: add real DJBILBOX beat in CapCut; AI audio optional
defaults.text_overlay_rule: never generate text with AI; add logo, code and CTA in post
defaults.negative: text, watermark, logo, distorted hands, extra fingers, blurry, low quality, deformed instruments

spots.title: Crypt Studio - Halloween Sale
spots.hook_0_1.5s: hand slams glowing orange pad, ground cracks, coffin blasts open
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic horror-comedy. Extreme close-up of a producer's hand slamming a glowing orange drum pad in a candlelit crypt studio, fog on the floor. The kick cracks the ground and a coffin lid blasts open. Skeletons in oversized headphones rise and headbang in sync to a heavy G-Funk trap beat, bats burst out of a giant analog synth. Fast push-in to a jack-o'-lantern skull with gold chains and headphones who turns to camera and smirks.
spots.lighting: orange and purple, volumetric fog, lightning accents

spots.title: Plugin Comes Alive
spots.hook_0_1.5s: knob turns by itself with red glitch flash
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 premium product film. Dark minimalist studio, a laptop DAW screen glows with a futuristic [PLUGIN_NAME] interface. A knob turns by itself, red glitch flash, the whole room pulses to the kick, studio monitors shake, dust and sparks float in slow motion. Final shot: a producer silhouette lifts his head, eyes glowing [COLOR].
spots.camera: slow dolly-in on screen, rack focus to speakers, final low angle
spots.lighting: rim light, [COLOR] neon accents, shallow depth of field

spots.title: Before / After Sound
spots.hook_0_1.5s: gray silent room, hard cut at the drop
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16. Left half of the story: a dull gray empty studio, flat lifeless lighting, silent. Hard cut at the drop: the same room explodes into color, gold and magenta lights, vibrating subwoofers, glowing audio waveforms spiraling in the air like confetti. Fast whip transition, high energy.
spots.camera: locked-off first shot, then fast orbit
spots.lighting: desaturated flat to saturated neon gold and magenta

spots.title: Empire du Beat
spots.hook_0_1.5s: throne of drum machines rises at the first kick
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 epic cinematic. Low-angle shot of a king-like beatmaker seated on a throne built from drum machines and speakers, a crowd of silhouettes below, gold smoke rolling. At the drop the throne rises, lights flare, the camera orbits fast around him. G-Funk West Coast vibe, sunset gold and purple.
spots.camera: low angle hero shot, fast 360 orbit
spots.lighting: golden hour backlight, purple haze, lens flares

spots.title: Drum Kit Unboxing
spots.hook_0_1.5s: black box opens and drum hits burst out in slow motion
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 clean product-shot. Hands open a glowing matte-black box, 3D drum hits, vinyl pieces and audio waveforms float out in slow motion. The camera dives into the box and reveals a pristine producer studio. Crisp highlights, reflective black surface, [COLOR] accent light.
spots.lighting: softbox key, [COLOR] edge light, glossy reflections

spots.title: Free VST Drop
spots.hook_0_1.5s: gift box lands with shockwave and sparks
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 high-energy ad. A glowing gift box slams onto a studio desk with a shockwave, sparks and floating musical notes. The lid flies open and a holographic synth interface projects above it, keys lighting up one by one. Fast, punchy, friendly, bright colors.
spots.camera: static impact shot, quick push-in to hologram
spots.lighting: bright key, cyan and orange accents, particle glow

spots.title: Guitar Pedal Effects
spots.hook_0_1.5s: boot stomps a pedal and the amp erupts in sparks
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 gritty cinematic. A worn leather boot stomps a vintage guitar effects pedal, the LED flashes red, a tube amplifier erupts in warm sparks and smoke. Slow-motion guitar strings vibrate, sound waves distort the air visibly. Dark garage-studio, analog textures.
spots.camera: ground-level boot stomp, slow-motion string close-up
spots.lighting: tungsten practicals, red LED accent, smoke backlight

spots.title: Oriental Trap
spots.hook_0_1.5s: lantern light flares as a trap kick hits
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 luxury cinematic. Arabian-night rooftop at dusk, glowing lanterns, a producer behind a sleek MIDI keyboard. At the first kick golden light ripples across the city, ornate patterns of light dance in the air to an oriental melody. Slow elegant camera glide ending on the producer's silhouette against a huge moon.
spots.camera: slow crane glide, parallax over rooftops
spots.lighting: deep indigo sky, gold lantern glow, moon rim light

spots.title: FL Studio Producer POV
spots.hook_0_1.5s: POV hands slam the keyboard, screens flash to the beat
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 first-person POV. Hands over a MIDI controller and laptop at 3 a.m., neon city through the window. Hands slam the pads, three monitors flash to the beat, plugin windows slide open one after another in a rhythmic cascade, cables glow. Cut at the final hit to a satisfied smirk reflected in a screen.
spots.camera: handheld POV, quick rack focuses, mirror-reflection ending
spots.lighting: neon pink and cyan city light, screen glow

spots.title: Merch Drop Fourthwall
spots.hook_0_1.5s: hoodie whip-pans into frame with smoke burst
spots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 streetwear lookbook. A model in a black hoodie and gold chain whip-pans into frame with a smoke burst, urban night alley, fast cuts of fabric details, a sneaker stomp, a cap spin. Slow-motion finish with the model turning to camera against neon haze.
spots.camera: whip-pan entry, fast detail cuts, slow-motion finish
spots.lighting: neon haze, hard flash fill, wet pavement reflections
